name: TAL bHLH transcription factor 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TAL2 encodes t-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and protein dimerization activity. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: TAL2 activation through rearrangements involving the T-cell receptor locus has been described in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
